verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passwordless sign-in and credential app. User-configured autonomous background automations are outside what this kind of product does, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Built-in automatic behaviors such as hourly location sharing or cloud backup are fixed app functions, not automations a user sets up, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
